rationale: Media-ownership registry: mine once to enumerate Serbian-language Kosovo outlets, then archive; not a tender signal producer.
Standalone Serbian-language aggregator giving one crawl point across many enclave outlets that report on tenders/awards.
Active Serbian-language portal covering Procurement Review Body decisions; durable news hub for the XK tender beat.
Sub-page of rks-gov.net (42 siblings) and URL fetch failed; regulator vocabulary is valuable but covered by monitoring the parent portal.
Single archived PDF of a superseded 2007 law; useful as vocabulary evidence, static and URL unverified.
E-service delivery portal on rks-gov.net with no tender publication of its own; relevant only as context on public-sector payment rails.
Standalone buyer procurement page for the utility serving Serb-majority areas; recurring cash-collection/billing contracts outside Kosovo portals.
Tax administration publishes its own award notices and is a major buyer of payment-collection and card-acceptance services.
Authoritative BQK register of licensed banks, payment/e-money and NBFI institutions: the master buyer universe, refreshed continuously.
Dated PDF snapshot behind the BQK register page; collect via the parent register rather than as a separate monitored source.
Banking association member list enumerates commercial banks; mine once, with occasional refresh for sector-infrastructure news.
Compulsory deposit-insurance membership list is an independent cross-check on the licensed-bank universe.
Official business registry for resolving bidder/supplier identities; access status unknown and search is form-gated, so clear access first.
Open, queryable mirror of ARBK; far more collectable for bulk supplier and ownership enrichment behind award analysis.
Civic-tech ARBK dataset explicitly linking business registration to procurement; harvest the dataset once, refresh on release.
Normalised copy of XK company records with stable IDs; useful for cross-border parent tracing, not a continuous signal feed.
Aleph ARBK dataset is investigative-grade but access/licensing unclear; revisit if ownership tracing becomes a priority.
ICT association directory is the candidate-supplier universe for banking/payments IT tenders; mine once for competitor mapping.
Chamber membership adds mid-size IT/services suppliers but is broad and largely redundant with STIKK/AmCham.
Clean browsable directory enumerating banks, fintech and IT vendors active in Kosovo; one-pass scrape.
German-Kosovar chamber member list is a compact lead list but the URL failed verification; recheck liveness before mining.
Enumerates the microfinance/NBFI tier that buys core banking, lending and payment systems; easily missed otherwise.
Insurance bureau enumerates adjacent buyers of payment/claims/IT systems; secondary to the banking and payments core.
